from pathlib import Path
import datetime,json,os,signal,subprocess,time,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from action_eval.config import load_experiment
base=Path('/data/chenjiayu/wenbiao_zhao/dreamwam-sr')
work=base/'action-eval-prompt-aa5f5fa'
out=base/'outputs/prompt-cache-paired-20260920'
meta={'status':'ADMISSION','start_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'pid':os.getpid(),'evaluator_commit':'aa5f5fa7815702ee9dd00aedca2a9e94d0ff9133','model_commit':'04163905f047169a159b3e366d679afc86392757','renderer':4,'policy_gpu':2,'pilot_episodes_per_arm':15,'runs':[],'sr':None,'notes':['new matched rendering lineage; no pooling with earlier runs','shared compute GPU; no performance claim from these episode wall times']}
def save():
 (out/'pilot-pair-controller.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
def inventory():
 xml=ET.fromstring(subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','-q','-x'],text=True,timeout=20))
 return [dict(index=i,uuid=g.findtext('uuid'),util=int(g.findtext('utilization/gpu_util').split()[0]),free=int(g.findtext('fb_memory_usage/free').split()[0]),processes=[{k:t.findtext(k) for k in ['pid','type','process_name']} for t in g.findall('processes/process_info')]) for i,g in enumerate(xml.findall('gpu'))]
def gpu_record(gpus,arm,phase):
 row={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'arm':arm,'phase':phase,'gpus':gpus}
 with (out/'pilot-pair-gpus.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
 return row
def admission(arm):
 limit=time.monotonic()+45
 while True:
  g=inventory();row=gpu_record(g,arm,'admission')
  spares=[i for i in [1,5] if g[i]['util']<=20 and g[i]['free']>=35000 and not any('G' in p['type'] for p in g[i]['processes'])]
  if not g[4]['processes'] and g[4]['util']<=20 and g[4]['free']>=35000 and g[2]['util']<=20 and g[2]['free']>=35000 and not any('G' in p['type'] for p in g[2]['processes']) and spares:
   row['spare_unused_by_this_task']=spares
   return row
  if time.monotonic()>=limit:return None
  time.sleep(3)
def stop_owned(proc):
 if proc.poll() is not None:return
 os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGINT)
 try:proc.wait(timeout=25)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  proc.wait(timeout=20)
save()
try:
 pre=json.loads((out/'preflight-aa5f5fa/preflight.json').read_text())
 assert all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in pre['commands']) and pre['schema_matches_committed']
 adapter=json.loads((base/'outputs/prompt-cache-20260920/adapter-0416390/report.json').read_text())
 assert adapter['status']=='VERIFIED'
 for arm,kind in [('dense','conditioned'),('sparse','guided')]:
  config=work/f'configs/experiments/dreamwam-prompt-{kind}-pilot.yaml'
  loaded=load_experiment(config,require_paths=True)
  approved=admission(arm)
  if approved is None:
   meta['status']='RESOURCE_WINDOW_CLOSED';meta['waiting_arm']=arm;break
  root=out/f'{arm}-pilot-gpu2-render4'
  root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
  cmd=[str(work/'.venv/bin/python'),'scripts/supplement-libero.py',str(config),'--render-gpu',os.environ['RENDER_GPU_UUID'],'--output',str(root),'--check-native-writes']
  entry={'arm':arm,'start_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'admission':approved,'command':cmd,'output':str(root),'fingerprint_verified':False}
  meta['runs'].append(entry)
  log=(root/'launch.log').open('x')
  proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=work,env=os.environ.copy(),stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
  entry['pid']=proc.pid;meta['status']='RUNNING';save()
  deadline=time.monotonic()+1800;violation=None
  try:
   while proc.poll() is None:
    g=inventory();gpu_record(g,arm,'running')
    if any('C' in p['type'] or ('G' in p['type'] and int(p['pid'])!=proc.pid) for p in g[4]['processes']):
     violation='renderer_resource_window_closed';break
    if time.monotonic()>=deadline:violation='bounded_pilot_wall_limit';break
    path=root/'run/provenance.json'
    if not entry['fingerprint_verified'] and path.exists():
     provenance=json.loads(path.read_text());fingerprint=provenance.get('policy_worker',{}).get('description',{}).get('fingerprint')
     if fingerprint is not None:
      expected=loaded.config.policy.options
      if any(fingerprint.get(k)!=expected[k] for k in ['visual_cache','prompt_cache','action_horizon','denoising_steps','rng_mode']) or fingerprint.get('checkpoint_sha256')!='6c087e5b9e201f19dbe92834b470a7ee18937a18ea9adcbb49886aa1e3ac4c61':
       violation='executed_policy_fingerprint_mismatch';break
      entry['fingerprint_verified']=True;save()
    time.sleep(3)
  finally:
   if violation or proc.poll() is None:stop_owned(proc)
   log.close()
  entry.update(exit_code=proc.returncode,end_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),stop_reason=violation)
  (root/'launch.exit').write_text(str(proc.returncode)+'\n')
  save()
  if violation or proc.returncode!=0 or not entry['fingerprint_verified']:
   meta['status']='STOPPED_REQUIRES_REVIEW';break
 else:meta['status']='PILOT_PAIR_COMPLETE'
except BaseException as exc:
 meta['status']='ERROR';meta['error']=repr(exc)
 raise
finally:
 meta['end_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();save()
